subject.title: fix: recover stuck Control UI chat runs

question: Should this bot replacement PR wait for real Control UI browser/gateway proof, receive a maintainer proof override, or be paused in favor of a fresh port onto the current chat module split?
rationale: The code path is a plausible fix for an open linked bug, but it is conflicting and lacks the real behavior proof required for this user-visible session/message recovery path.

options.title: Port and prove the current branch
options.body: Refresh the branch onto the split ui/src/pages/chat implementation and capture redacted Control UI proof showing stale-run recovery, history reload, queued follow-up flush, and no transient error banner.

options.title: Apply proof override
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally waive the proof gate if the source-level tests and code review are enough for this bot replacement PR.

options.title: Pause and replace
options.body: Close or pause this branch and create a fresh narrower PR if rebasing the old module patch is more churn than rebuilding the fix in current files.

recommendation.title: Port and prove the current branch
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch onto the split ui/src/pages/chat implementation and capture redacted Control UI proof showing stale-run recovery, history reload, queued follow-up flush, and no transient error banner.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main affected chat modules and the central busy/queue code blame to Vincent's recent consolidation commit, so they are the best available owner signal for the rebase/port decision.
